pfd-left.title: Left Primary Flight Display (PFD 1)
pfd-left.description: Displays Captain primary flight instruments: Attitude Director Indicator (ADI), airspeed/Mach tape, altitude tape, vertical speed indicator, Horizontal Situation Indicator (HSI), and Flight Mode Annunciations (FMA).

mfd-left.title: Left Multi-Function Display (MFD 1)
mfd-left.description: Displays interactive lateral/vertical navigation map, system synoptics (Electrical, Hydraulic, Fuel, ECS, Flight Controls, Brakes), electronic checklists, and flight plan pages for the Captain.

mfd-right.title: Right Multi-Function Display (MFD 2 / EICAS)
mfd-right.description: Displays EICAS primary engine indications (N1, ITT, N2, FF, Oil), Crew Alerting System (CAS) messages, flap/gear/trim status, and system synoptic pages for the First Officer.

pfd-right.title: Right Primary Flight Display (PFD 2)
pfd-right.description: Displays First Officer primary flight instruments: attitude, airspeed, barometric altitude, vertical speed, heading/HSI, and AFCS Flight Mode Annunciations (FMA).

isis-screen.title: ISIS Display Screen (Standby Instrument)
isis-screen.description: Integrated Standby Instrument System LCD screen providing independent attitude, airspeed, altitude, and heading/ILS indications in case of primary display failure.

mcdu-left-screen.title: Left MCDU Display Screen (MCDU 1)
mcdu-left-screen.description: Multifunction Control Display Unit 1 screen displaying FMS flight plan, performance, navigation, radio management, and datalink pages.

mcdu-right-screen.title: Right MCDU Display Screen (MCDU 2)
mcdu-right-screen.description: Multifunction Control Display Unit 2 screen displaying independent FMS, radio tuning, and datalink pages for the First Officer.

dvdr-test-btn.title: CVR / DVDR Test Pushbutton
dvdr-test-btn.description: Initiates a built-in test of the Digital Voice and Data Recorder (Cockpit Voice Recorder & Flight Data Recorder).

dvdr-erase-btn.title: CVR / DVDR Erase Pushbutton
dvdr-erase-btn.description: Erases cockpit voice recordings when the aircraft is on the ground and the parking brake is applied.

elt-switch.title: ELT Selector Switch (ARM / ON)
elt-switch.description: Controls the Emergency Locator Transmitter. ARM: Automatically transmits on impact. ON: Manually activates emergency transmission.

elec-idg1-knob.title: IDG 1 Selector Knob (DISC / OFF / AUTO)
elec-idg1-knob.description: Controls Integrated Drive Generator 1. AUTO: Connects IDG 1 to AC Bus 1. OFF: Opens generator line contactor. DISC (guarded): Mechanically disconnects IDG 1 from Engine 1 gearbox.

elec-idg2-knob.title: IDG 2 Selector Knob (DISC / OFF / AUTO)
elec-idg2-knob.description: Controls Integrated Drive Generator 2. AUTO: Connects IDG 2 to AC Bus 2. OFF: Opens generator line contactor. DISC (guarded): Mechanically disconnects IDG 2 from Engine 2 gearbox.

elec-apu-gen-btn.title: APU GEN Pushbutton
elec-apu-gen-btn.description: Connects or disconnects the Auxiliary Power Unit (APU) starter-generator to/from the AC electrical network.

elec-gpu-btn.title: AC GPU Pushbutton
elec-gpu-btn.description: Connects external AC Ground Power Unit to the aircraft electrical buses when AVAIL is illuminated.

elec-ac-bus-ties-knob.title: AC Bus Ties Selector Knob
elec-ac-bus-ties-knob.description: Controls AC Bus Tie Contactors (BTC 1 & 2). AUTO: Automatic power transfer between AC Bus 1 and AC Bus 2. 1 OPEN / 2 OPEN: Isolates the respective AC bus.

elec-tru1-knob.title: TRU 1 Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO)
elec-tru1-knob.description: Controls Transformer Rectifier Unit 1, which converts 115V AC to 28V DC for DC Bus 1.

elec-tru-ess-knob.title: TRU ESS Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO)
elec-tru-ess-knob.description: Controls the Essential Transformer Rectifier Unit supplying DC Essential Bus power.

elec-tru2-knob.title: TRU 2 Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO)
elec-tru2-knob.description: Controls Transformer Rectifier Unit 2, which converts 115V AC to 28V DC for DC Bus 2.

elec-batt1-knob.title: BATT 1 Selector Knob (OFF / ON)
elec-batt1-knob.description: Connects or disconnects Battery 1 (24V Ni-Cd) to/from the DC electrical system.

elec-batt2-knob.title: BATT 2 Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO)
elec-batt2-knob.description: Connects Battery 2 to the automatic battery bus and essential power network in AUTO mode.

elec-dc-bus-ties-knob.title: DC Bus Ties Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO)
elec-dc-bus-ties-knob.description: Controls DC Bus Tie contactors allowing automatic cross-tie between DC Bus 1, DC Bus 2, and DC ESS Bus.

ckpt-ovhd-lt-knob.title: Overhead Panel Backlighting Knob
ckpt-ovhd-lt-knob.description: Adjusts the integral backlighting intensity of the overhead panel.

ckpt-main-lt-knob.title: Main Panel Backlighting Knob
ckpt-main-lt-knob.description: Adjusts the integral backlighting intensity of the main instrument panel and glareshield.

ckpt-ped-lt-knob.title: Pedestal Backlighting Knob
ckpt-ped-lt-knob.description: Adjusts the integral backlighting intensity of the control pedestal.

ckpt-dome-btn.title: Cockpit Dome Light Switch
ckpt-dome-btn.description: Turns the overhead cockpit flood/dome illumination ON or OFF.

ckpt-annun-test-sw.title: Annunciator Test / Storm Light Switch
ckpt-annun-test-sw.description: Tests all cockpit annunciator lights when held to TEST, or sets maximum cockpit flood lighting in STORM position.

fire-eng1-handle.title: Engine 1 Fire Extinguisher Handle
fire-eng1-handle.description: Pulling the handle closes Engine 1 fuel, hydraulic, and bleed air shutoff valves, trips IDG 1, and arms the fire extinguishing bottles. Rotating LEFT (A) or RIGHT (B) discharges the respective Halon bottle.

fire-cargo-fwd-btn.title: Forward Cargo Smoke / Extinguisher Pushbutton
fire-cargo-fwd-btn.description: Illuminates when smoke is detected in the forward cargo compartment. Pressing arms and discharges the high-rate/low-rate cargo fire extinguishing bottles.

fire-cargo-aft-btn.title: Aft Cargo Smoke / Extinguisher Pushbutton
fire-cargo-aft-btn.description: Illuminates when smoke is detected in the aft cargo compartment. Pressing arms and discharges the cargo fire extinguishing agent.

fire-apu-extg-btn.title: APU Fire Extinguisher Pushbutton
fire-apu-extg-btn.description: Discharges the APU fire extinguisher bottle into the APU compartment when armed by the APU Fire Emergency Stop button.

fire-apu-emer-btn.title: APU Fire Emergency Stop Guarded Button
fire-apu-emer-btn.description: Illuminates red during an APU fire condition. Pressing shuts down the APU, closes the APU fuel shutoff valve, trips the APU generator, and arms the APU extinguisher bottle.

fire-eng2-handle.title: Engine 2 Fire Extinguisher Handle
fire-eng2-handle.description: Pulling the handle isolates Engine 2 fuel, hydraulics, bleed air, and electrical generation, and arms the fire extinguishing bottles. Rotating LEFT (A) or RIGHT (B) discharges the bottle.

fuel-xfeed-knob.title: Fuel Crossfeed Selector Knob (LOW 1 / OFF / LOW 2)
fuel-xfeed-knob.description: Controls fuel balance between left and right wing tanks. LOW 1: Opens crossfeed valve and turns off Tank 1 pump so Tank 2 feeds both engines. LOW 2: Tank 1 feeds both engines.

fuel-ac-pump1-btn.title: AC Fuel Pump 1 Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
fuel-ac-pump1-btn.description: Controls Left Wing Tank main AC-powered ejector/boost fuel pump.

fuel-ac-pump2-btn.title: AC Fuel Pump 2 Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
fuel-ac-pump2-btn.description: Controls Right Wing Tank main AC-powered ejector/boost fuel pump.

fuel-dc-pump-btn.title: DC Fuel Pump Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
fuel-dc-pump-btn.description: Controls the DC-powered fuel pump located in the right wing collector tank for APU starting and backup engine fuel feed when AC power is unavailable.

pax-emer-lt-knob.title: Emergency Lights Selector Knob (OFF / ARM / ON)
pax-emer-lt-knob.description: Controls cabin and exterior emergency escape path lighting. ARM: Automatically illuminates emergency lights if aircraft DC/AC power fails.

pax-sterile-btn.title: Sterile Cockpit Light Pushbutton
pax-sterile-btn.description: Illuminates the sterile cockpit indicator in the forward cabin to notify flight attendants that the flight crew is in a critical phase of flight.

pax-no-smk-sw.title: No Smoking Sign Switch (OFF / AUTO / ON)
pax-no-smk-sw.description: Controls the cabin No Smoking / Electronic Devices signs and chime.

pax-fstn-belts-sw.title: Fasten Seat Belts Sign Switch (OFF / ON)
pax-fstn-belts-sw.description: Illuminates cabin Fasten Seat Belts signs and sounds the cabin chime.

pax-cabin-lt-sw.title: Cabin Lights Override Switch
pax-cabin-lt-sw.description: Allows cockpit control of cabin lighting when required.

apu-fuel-shutoff-btn.title: APU Fuel Shutoff Guarded Pushbutton
apu-fuel-shutoff-btn.description: Closes the APU fuel shutoff valve to isolate fuel supply to the Auxiliary Power Unit.

apu-emer-stop-btn.title: APU Emergency Stop Pushbutton
apu-emer-stop-btn.description: Immediately shuts down the APU without the normal cooldown cycle and closes the APU fuel shutoff valve.

apu-master.title: APU Master Selector Knob (OFF / ON / START)
apu-master.description: Controls the Auxiliary Power Unit. OFF: Initiates normal cooldown and shutdown. ON: Powers APU FADEC and opens fuel valve. START: Momentary position that initiates the automatic APU start sequence.

wiper-left-knob.title: Windshield Wiper 1 (Captain) Knob
wiper-left-knob.description: Controls the Captain windshield wiper speed: OFF, TIMER (intermittent), LOW, or HIGH.

wiper-right-knob.title: Windshield Wiper 2 (First Officer) Knob
wiper-right-knob.description: Controls the First Officer windshield wiper speed: OFF, TIMER (intermittent), LOW, or HIGH.

ext-nav-sw.title: NAV Lights Switch
ext-nav-sw.description: Turns the red/green wingtip and white tail position/navigation lights ON or OFF.

ext-strobe-sw.title: STROBE Lights Switch
ext-strobe-sw.description: Turns the high-intensity white wingtip and tail anti-collision strobe lights ON or OFF.

ext-bcn-sw.title: RED BEACON Switch
ext-bcn-sw.description: Turns upper and lower fuselage red anti-collision beacon lights ON or OFF (turned ON prior to engine start).

ext-logo-sw.title: LOGO Lights Switch
ext-logo-sw.description: Illuminates the vertical stabilizer emblem for night operations.

ext-insp-sw.title: INSP (Wing Inspection) Lights Switch
ext-insp-sw.description: Illuminates the wing leading edges to visually check for ice accumulation at night.

ext-taxi-nose-sw.title: TAXI Nose Light Switch
ext-taxi-nose-sw.description: Turns the nose-gear-mounted taxi light ON or OFF (automatically extinguishes when nose gear retracts).

ext-taxi-side-sw.title: TAXI Side / Turnoff Lights Switch
ext-taxi-side-sw.description: Turns the wide-beam runway turnoff / side taxi lights ON or OFF.

ext-ldg-left-sw.title: Left Landing Light Switch
ext-ldg-left-sw.description: Controls the left wing root high-intensity landing light.

ext-ldg-nose-sw.title: Nose Landing Light Switch
ext-ldg-nose-sw.description: Controls the nose-gear high-intensity landing light.

ext-ldg-right-sw.title: Right Landing Light Switch
ext-ldg-right-sw.description: Controls the right wing root high-intensity landing light.

hyd-sys1-shutoff-btn.title: Hydraulic System 1 Engine Pump Shutoff Button
hyd-sys1-shutoff-btn.description: Guarded pushbutton that closes the Hydraulic System 1 engine-driven pump (EDP 1) supply shutoff valve.

hyd-ptu-knob.title: PTU (Power Transfer Unit) Selector Knob
hyd-ptu-knob.description: Controls the mechanical Power Transfer Unit between Hydraulic Systems 1 and 2 (OFF / AUTO / ON) to assist landing gear retraction/extension if an engine fails.

hyd-sys2-shutoff-btn.title: Hydraulic System 2 Engine Pump Shutoff Button
hyd-sys2-shutoff-btn.description: Guarded pushbutton that closes the Hydraulic System 2 engine-driven pump (EDP 2) supply shutoff valve.

hyd-sys1-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 1 Electric Pump Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
hyd-sys1-elec-pump-knob.description: Controls AC Motor Pump 1 (ACMP 1) providing backup and ground hydraulic pressure for System 1.

hyd-sys2-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 2 Electric Pump Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
hyd-sys2-elec-pump-knob.description: Controls AC Motor Pump 2 (ACMP 2) providing backup and ground hydraulic pressure for System 2.

hyd-sys3a-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 3 Electric Pump A Knob (OFF / ON)
hyd-sys3a-elec-pump-knob.description: Controls primary AC Motor Pump 3A (ACMP 3A) pressurizing Hydraulic System 3 for flight controls.

hyd-sys3b-elec-pump-knob.title: Hydraulic System 3 Electric Pump B Knob (OFF / AUTO / ON)
hyd-sys3b-elec-pump-knob.description: Controls backup AC Motor Pump 3B (ACMP 3B) for Hydraulic System 3.

press-cabin-alt-knob.title: Manual Cabin Altitude / Outflow Valve Switch (UP / DN)
press-cabin-alt-knob.description: Spring-loaded rotary switch used in MAN mode to manually open (UP) or close (DN) the cabin outflow valve.

press-mode-knob.title: Pressurization Mode Selector Knob (AUTO / LFE CTRL / MAN)
press-mode-knob.description: Selects automatic FMS/CPCS cabin pressurization control (AUTO), manual landing field elevation entry (LFE CTRL), or direct manual outflow valve control (MAN).

press-dump-btn.title: Cabin Dump Guarded Pushbutton
press-dump-btn.description: Emergency guarded button that turns off both air conditioning packs and commands the outflow valve fully open for rapid cabin depressurization / smoke removal.

press-lfe-knob.title: LFE (Landing Field Elevation) Selector Knob
press-lfe-knob.description: Adjusts the target Landing Field Elevation on EICAS when the Pressurization Mode knob is set to LFE CTRL.

ice-wshld1-btn.title: Windshield 1 Heating Pushbutton
ice-wshld1-btn.description: Activates electrical anti-ice and anti-fog heating for the Captain windshield.

ice-wshld2-btn.title: Windshield 2 Heating Pushbutton
ice-wshld2-btn.description: Activates electrical anti-ice and anti-fog heating for the First Officer windshield.

ice-wing-btn.title: Wing Anti-Ice Pushbutton
ice-wing-btn.description: Commands the wing anti-ice valves open to supply hot bleed air to the wing leading edge slats.

ice-mode-knob.title: Ice Protection Mode Selector Knob (AUTO / ON)
ice-mode-knob.description: Selects automatic ice detector control (AUTO) or continuous manual activation (ON) of the engine and wing anti-ice systems.

ice-test-knob.title: Ice Detection Test Selector Knob (ENG / OFF / WING)
ice-test-knob.description: Performs a built-in functional test of the engine and wing ice protection systems.

pneu-ckpt-temp-knob.title: Cockpit Temperature Selector Knob
pneu-ckpt-temp-knob.description: Adjusts the target temperature for the cockpit zone (18°C to 30°C).

pneu-recirc-btn.title: Cabin Recirculation Fan Pushbutton
pneu-recirc-btn.description: Controls the cabin air recirculation fans to reduce bleed air demand.

pneu-pax-temp-knob.title: Cabin Temperature Selector Knob
pneu-pax-temp-knob.description: Adjusts the target temperature for the passenger cabin zone.

pneu-pack1-btn.title: Pack 1 Pushbutton
pneu-pack1-btn.description: Opens or closes Air Conditioning Pack 1 flow control valve.

pneu-pack2-btn.title: Pack 2 Pushbutton
pneu-pack2-btn.description: Opens or closes Air Conditioning Pack 2 flow control valve.

pneu-xbleed-btn.title: Crossbleed Valve Pushbutton
pneu-xbleed-btn.description: Controls the pneumatic crossbleed valve connecting the left and right pneumatic manifolds for engine starting, anti-ice, or single-bleed pack operation.

pneu-bleed1-btn.title: Engine 1 Bleed Pushbutton
pneu-bleed1-btn.description: Opens or closes Engine 1 bleed air pressure regulating and shutoff valve.

pneu-apu-bleed-btn.title: APU Bleed Pushbutton
pneu-apu-bleed-btn.description: Opens or closes the APU bleed air valve to supply pneumatic air for air conditioning packs and engine starting.

pneu-bleed2-btn.title: Engine 2 Bleed Pushbutton
pneu-bleed2-btn.description: Opens or closes Engine 2 bleed air pressure regulating and shutoff valve.

oxy-mask-knob.title: Passenger Oxygen Mask Deployment Knob (AUTO / OVRD)
oxy-mask-knob.description: AUTO: Deploys cabin oxygen masks automatically if cabin altitude exceeds ~14,000 ft. OVRD: Manually deploys cabin oxygen masks.

oxy-supply-btn.title: Passenger Oxygen Supply Pushbutton
oxy-supply-btn.description: Controls oxygen flow to the deployed passenger cabin masks.

master-warn-left.title: Left Master Warning (WARN) Pushbutton
master-warn-left.description: Flashes red and sounds a triple chime when a Level 3 Warning CAS message occurs. Pressing extinguishes the flash and silences the aural warning.

master-caut-left.title: Left Master Caution (CAUT) Pushbutton
master-caut-left.description: Illuminates amber and sounds a single chime when a Level 2 Caution CAS message occurs. Pressing resets the caution light.

master-caut-right.title: Right Master Caution (CAUT) Pushbutton
master-caut-right.description: First Officer amber Master Caution reset pushbutton.

master-warn-right.title: Right Master Warning (WARN) Pushbutton
master-warn-right.description: First Officer red Master Warning reset pushbutton.

dcu1-baro-knob.title: Left Barometric Altimeter Knob (BARO / STD)
dcu1-baro-knob.description: Sets the Captain barometric pressure reference (inHg or hPa). Pushing the center button toggles STD (29.92 inHg / 1013 hPa).

dcu1-buttons.title: Left Display Controller Pushbuttons (HSI / WX / TFC / FPV)
dcu1-buttons.description: Toggles PFD 1 Flight Path Vector (FPV), HSI format (ARC/COMP), BRG pointers, Weather Radar overlay (WX), and TCAS Traffic overlay (TFC).

dcu1-mins-knob.title: Left Minimums Selector Knob (RA / BARO)
dcu1-mins-knob.description: Selects Radio Altimeter (RA) or Barometric (BARO) decision height/altitude bug on PFD 1.

fgp-fd1-btn.title: Left Flight Director (FD 1) Button
fgp-fd1-btn.description: Toggles the Captain Flight Director command bars on PFD 1.

fgp-crs1-knob.title: Left Course (CRS 1) Selector Knob
fgp-crs1-knob.description: Sets the selected VOR/LOC course pointer for the Captain HSI. Pushing centers the course deviation needle.

fgp-at-btn.title: Autothrottle (A/T) Engage Button
fgp-at-btn.description: Arms or engages the Automatic Throttle system.

fgp-spd-knob.title: Airspeed / Mach Selector Knob (FMS / MAN)
fgp-spd-knob.description: Outer ring selects FMS-computed speed or Manual speed control. Inner knob sets target IAS/Mach; pushing toggles IAS/Mach mode.

fgp-nav-btn.title: LNAV / Lateral Navigation (NAV) Button
fgp-nav-btn.description: Arms or engages lateral navigation mode (FMS LNAV or VOR/LOC capture).

fgp-hdg-knob.title: Heading (HDG) Selector & Sync Knob
fgp-hdg-knob.description: Rotates to set the selected heading bug on the PFD/MFD. Pushing syncs the heading bug to the current aircraft heading.

fgp-appr-btn.title: Approach (APPR) Mode Button
fgp-appr-btn.description: Arms lateral and vertical approach guidance (ILS LOC/GS or RNAV RNP/LPV approach).

fgp-bank-btn.title: Half Bank Limit (BANK) Button
fgp-bank-btn.description: Limits Flight Director / Autopilot roll bank angle to 17° in HDG mode.

fgp-ap-btn.title: Autopilot (AP) Engage Pushbutton
fgp-ap-btn.description: Engages or disengages the Automatic Flight Control System Autopilot.

fgp-yd-src-btns.title: Yaw Damper (YD) & Navigation Source (SRC) Buttons
fgp-yd-src-btns.description: YD engages/disengages the Yaw Damper; SRC switches the active Flight Director master side (Captain / First Officer).

fgp-vnav-flch-btns.title: VNAV & Flight Level Change (FLCH) Buttons
fgp-vnav-flch-btns.description: Engages FMS Vertical Navigation (VNAV) profile guidance or Flight Level Change (FLCH) airspeed-on-pitch climb/descent.

fgp-vs-wheel.title: Vertical Speed / FPA Pitch Wheel & Button
fgp-vs-wheel.description: Engages Vertical Speed (VS) or Flight Path Angle (FPA) mode; thumbwheel adjusts the target rate of climb/descent or flight path angle.

fgp-alt-knob.title: Altitude Selector Knob (ALT)
fgp-alt-knob.description: Sets the preselected altitude on the PFD (outer ring 1000 ft, inner knob 100 ft).

fgp-fd2-crs2.title: Right Flight Director (FD 2) & Course 2 (CRS 2) Knob
fgp-fd2-crs2.description: Controls the First Officer Flight Director bars and VOR/LOC Course 2 pointer.

dcu2-mins-knob.title: Right Minimums Selector Knob (RA / BARO)
dcu2-mins-knob.description: Selects Radio Altimeter (RA) or Barometric (BARO) minimums bug on PFD 2.

dcu2-buttons.title: Right Display Controller Pushbuttons (HSI / WX / TFC / FPV)
dcu2-buttons.description: Toggles PFD 2 Flight Path Vector (FPV), HSI format, bearing pointers, Weather Radar overlay, and TCAS Traffic overlay.

dcu2-baro-knob.title: Right Barometric Altimeter Knob (BARO / STD)
dcu2-baro-knob.description: Sets the First Officer barometric pressure reference (inHg or hPa) or toggles STD.

clock-left-btn.title: Captain Digital Clock & Chronometer Controls
clock-left-btn.description: Controls UTC time display, elapsed flight time (ET), and stopwatch chronometer (CHR).

reversionary-left-knobs.title: Left Reversionary & Display Dimming Knobs
reversionary-left-knobs.description: Contains ADS/IRS sensor reversion buttons and individual brightness knobs for PFD 1 and MFD 1.

ldg-gear-lever.title: Landing Gear Control Lever (UP / OFF / DN)
ldg-gear-lever.description: Three-position landing gear selector lever (UP, OFF, DN) with downlock release button.

autobrake-knob.title: Autobrake Selector Knob (RTO / OFF / LO / MED / HI)
autobrake-knob.description: Selects automatic wheel braking deceleration level for landing (LO, MED, HI) or Rejected Takeoff (RTO) maximum braking.

gear-ovrd-btn.title: Landing Gear Downlock Override & Alternate Gear Button
gear-ovrd-btn.description: Allows overriding the landing gear lever mechanical lock or silencing landing gear aural warnings.

clock-right-btn.title: First Officer Digital Clock & Chronometer Controls
clock-right-btn.description: Controls UTC time display, elapsed flight time (ET), and stopwatch chronometer (CHR) for the First Officer.

reversionary-right-knobs.title: Right Reversionary & Display Dimming Knobs
reversionary-right-knobs.description: Contains ADS/IRS sensor reversion buttons and individual brightness knobs for MFD 2 and PFD 2.

mcdu-left-keys.title: Left MCDU Keypad & Function Buttons
mcdu-left-keys.description: Alphanumeric keypad and mode keys (RTE, FPL, PERF, NAV, PROG, MENU, RADIO, DLK) for MCDU 1.

mcdu-right-keys.title: Right MCDU Keypad & Function Buttons
mcdu-right-keys.description: Alphanumeric keypad and mode keys (RTE, FPL, PERF, NAV, PROG, MENU, RADIO, DLK) for MCDU 2.

eng1-ign-knob.title: Engine 1 Ignition Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / OVRD)
eng1-ign-knob.description: Controls Engine 1 igniters. AUTO: FADEC automatically controls ignition. OVRD: Continuous ignition on both igniters. OFF: Inhibits ignition for dry motoring.

eng2-ign-knob.title: Engine 2 Ignition Selector Knob (OFF / AUTO / OVRD)

eng1-start-knob.title: Engine 1 Start / Stop Selector Knob (STOP / RUN / START)
eng1-start-knob.description: Guarded rotary selector. RUN: Normal operating position. START: Momentary position initiating FADEC automatic start sequence. STOP: Shuts down Engine 1.

eng2-start-knob.title: Engine 2 Start / Stop Selector Knob (STOP / RUN / START)
eng2-start-knob.description: Guarded rotary selector for Engine 2 automatic starting (START), normal operation (RUN), and shutdown (STOP).

ccd-pedestal-left.title: Left Cursor Control Device (CCD 1 Touchpad & Keys)
ccd-pedestal-left.description: Touchpad, Enter keys, and display selection buttons allowing the Captain to move the cursor across PFD 1, MFD 1, and MCDU 1.

ccd-pedestal-right.title: Right Cursor Control Device (CCD 2 Touchpad & Keys)
ccd-pedestal-right.description: Touchpad, Enter keys, and display selection buttons allowing the First Officer to move the cursor across MFD 2, PFD 2, and MCDU 2.

speedbrake-lever.title: Speedbrake Lever (CLOSE / OPEN)
speedbrake-lever.description: Controls deployment of the wing multifunction spoilers as speedbrakes in flight.

thrust-levers.title: Engine 1 & 2 Thrust Levers (MAX / TOGA / MCT / IDLE / REV)
thrust-levers.description: Forward thrust and thrust-reverser levers with TO/GA (Takeoff/Go-Around) buttons and A/T quick-disconnect switches.

flap-lever.title: Flap Selector Lever (0 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 / FULL)
flap-lever.description: Selects wing trailing-edge flap and leading-edge slat positions for takeoff, approach, and landing.

parking-brake.title: Parking / Emergency Brake Handle
parking-brake.description: Pulling and rotating applies hydraulic parking brake pressure; also provides proportional emergency brake application.

pitch-trim-sw.title: Pitch & Roll Trim Control Switches
pitch-trim-sw.description: Backup pitch trim (NOSE UP / NOSE DN) and roll trim (LWD / RWD) switches with trim cutout pushbuttons.

yaw-trim-sw.title: Yaw Trim & Flight Control Mode Switches
yaw-trim-sw.description: Backup yaw trim switch and Flight Control (FCM) reset/mode switches.

acp-left-knobs.title: Left Audio Control Panel (ACP 1) Buttons & Volume Knobs
acp-left-knobs.description: Selects transmission and reception channels for VHF 1/2/3, HF, SATCOM, PA, Interphone, and navigation audio identifiers.

wx-tcas-knobs.title: Weather Radar & TCAS Control Knobs
wx-tcas-knobs.description: Controls Weather Radar tilt/gain and TCAS mode (STBY / TA ONLY / TA/RA).

alt-gear-lever.title: Alternate Landing Gear Free-Fall Lever
alt-gear-lever.description: Mechanically releases landing gear uplocks and vents hydraulic pressure to allow gravity free-fall extension of the landing gear.

rat-deploy-handle.title: RAT (Ram Air Turbine) Manual Deploy Handle
rat-deploy-handle.description: Manually deploys the Ram Air Turbine to provide emergency AC/DC electrical power.
